WHEN IT FITS

For teams managing repeatable listings that have outgrown static pages. The first step is a content model: categories, fields, relationships and how people should find the right entry.

What is included

  • Collection, category and field planning
  • Reusable listing and detail-page templates
  • Search and filter implementation within the agreed tools
  • Sample imports and content-management checks

What I need from you

  • A representative sample of real listings
  • The fields and categories visitors need
  • Search, filter and editing requirements

A clear scope from the beginning.

Membership systems, payments, custom backends and paid filter-tool subscriptions require separate evaluation and scope.
